rachel_ap: Invoice INV-9982 from LumenGrid hit exceptions. Vendor put entity 'Redwood EU' but PO PO-11009 is under 'Redwood US' so automatch failed. Also one line item amount seems higher than expected.
owen_procure: Can you paste the invoice lines and PO header?
rachel_ap: Snippet: ```Invoice INV-9982
Amount: $18,240.00
Lines: Dedicated inference pool - April (Qty 1) $18,240.00
Entity billed: Redwood EU
PO: (PO-11009)
```
PO header: ```PO-11009
Entity: Redwood US
Cost center: CC-60
```
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-9982 placed in exceptions due to entity mismatch and price variance (+8%). Required action: procurement confirmation and vendor follow-up.
sam_finance: 8% variance needs validation. Owen, did procurement approve a rate change?
owen_procure: No approved rate change. LumenGrid recently migrated billing entity for EMEA; they may have applied VAT or regional pricing. Rachel, ask vendor if this is VAT inclusive or a billing error.
vendor_bot: LumenGrid portal: "We show regional billing. Can reissue under Redwood US entity or provide credit for the delta."
rachel_ap: I've asked vendor to reissue invoice to Redwood US and to explain the extra charge. Created AP ticket AP-4792 and vendor follow-up.
ap_bot: Automated: AP ticket AP-4792 created. Status: Awaiting vendor reissue.
sam_finance: To avoid disrupting services, procurement can approve provisional payment for the PO amount ($16,900) and hold the delta until vendor responds.
owen_procure: Approved provisional payment of PO amount. Rachel, apply payment to invoice for $16,900 and hold $1,340 as disputed balance. Route approval to @sam_finance.
rachel_ap: Done 14 14 Applied partial payment and flagged disputed balance. AP shows: Paid $16,900 / Disputed $1,340. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/AP-4792
ap_bot: Automated: Notification sent to sam_finance for approval of provisional payment and dispute tracking.
sam_finance: Approved provisional payment. Created FIN-3602 to track dispute and credit memo. Will escalate if vendor doesn't reissue within 14 days.vendor_bot: LumenGrid: "We will reissue to Redwood US within 5 business days and credit the disputed amount if error."
rachel_ap: Thanks, closing loop once reissue received and credit applied. :white_check_mark:
